name: figma-wire
description: Wire any AI coding agent to Figma: probe/repair the local Dev Mode MCP server across harnesses (ZCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, Gemini CLI), parse share links, and call Figma MCP tools from plain bash — no MCP client required.
author: Adham Haitham <adhamhaithameid@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.test: SKIP_NETWORK_TESTS=1 bash tests/run-tests.sh && bash tests/e2e.sh && bash tests/test-domains.sh && bash tests/test-minimal-install.sh
